name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Over eight years of experience, finest handmade Infrared sauna units – both indoor and outdoor, top quality wood, direct control over the quality of each unit during construction and a test to ensure the perfect working and absence of any flaws or defects in the unit before shipping to the customer, various additional features (like radio, CD player, reading lights and etc.) – all this and much more makes Longevity one of the most successful and trustable sauna manufacturers in the United States.



Longevity Saunas are easy to purchase and even easier to be assembles without special tools or help. All parts easily clip together and make the sauna unit appealing and neat.



Each Infrared sauna unit is provided with a lifetime warranty on the wood, and an additional one year warranty on all the electronic parts used in the product (this includes heaters, radio, lights and etc) to help customers enjoy the full benefits of Infrared Sauna Therapy. There is no easier way to improve health, lose weight and relax after a long day, than take a session in a Longevity Infrared Sauna. No worries, no complications – just pure joy.
